kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
wire.summary: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi , Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the number of civilian casualties the Israeli military deems acceptable. The documentary is made by Israeli filmmakers.

wire.title: The U.S. added only 29,000 jobs in September as job market lacks spark
wire.summary: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September as the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%. Job gains for July and August were revised down by a total of 60,000 jobs, extending a lackluster run for the job market.

wire.title: Cornell rape case gets special prosecutor. And, Renee Good's family sues the government
wire.summary: New legal action in two closely watched cases: one at Cornell, the other over Renee Good's death. We take a closer look.

wire.title: Why is diesel more expensive than regular gas?
wire.summary: Diesel hasn't always been more expensive than other gasoline. Then in 2004, a switch happened due to air quality standards, demand, and taxes. In this week's Indicator newsletter, we dig into diesel prices, what kind of fun people are buying, and other forms of making your tax bill smaller.

wire.title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
wire.summary: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

wire.title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
wire.summary: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.

wire.title: Who uttered the phrase 'the ideological clowns are out' this week? The quiz knows
wire.summary: Plus, how well do you know your pandas and fat bears?

wire.title: Pro-democracy activists increasingly vulnerable to authoritarian governments in Southeast Asia
wire.summary: Activists across Asia are being hunted down by authoritarian governments even across international borders. Human rights groups have been warning of a "swap market" of repression in Southeast Asia.

wire.title: After bankruptcy, he was banned from sports betting sites. Then he discovered Kalshi
wire.summary: The dark side of the prediction market boom is becoming more clear: Experts say the sites have become go-to outlets for gambling addicts to relapse as the companies avoid state consumer protections.

wire.title: The U.S. Senate is up for grabs. Can this Ohio Democrat win back working class votes?
wire.summary: After 32 years in Congress, Ohio's Sherrod Brown lost his Senate seat in 2024 as many working class voters turned out for Trump. Now Brown is counting on union voters to send him back to Washington.

wire.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
wire.summary: More than 600 schools have faced disruption as protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.

wire.title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
wire.summary: The woman, known as Jane Doe, alleges she was raped by seven students at a fraternity house at the university in 2024.

wire.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
wire.summary: Capt Smit Machchhar tells Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi he opened the cockpit door to let others in during the attack.

wire.title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
wire.summary: Vitaliy Klitschko says Ukraine's capital is in a "very dramatic situation" as Russia hits critical infrastructure.

wire.title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
wire.summary: The defeat raises pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election, after a series of scandals affecting his party and allies.

wire.title: I've seen nearly 500 executions - but never one like Christa Pike's
wire.summary: Texas reporter Michael Graczyk has seen botched executions in his time, but not one in which an inmate survived.
